name: North Dakota
notes: North Dakota supports digital ID in Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select North Dakota from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your North Dakota driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the North Dakota DOT. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android device.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your North Dakota driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
The North Dakota DOT will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Scan the front and back of your North Dakota driver's license or ID.
The North Dakota DOT will verify and approve your digital ID.
